title: Czechia Caught Between Inflation Relief and Growth Anxiety · 21 Aug
keywords: Czechia, Czech economy, inflation, GDP growth, Czech National Bank, interest rates, Andrej Babiš, EU subsidies, European Public Prosecutor, Central Europe, economic outlook, rule of law, CNB monetary policy
notes: Czechia's economy is expanding, but only just, as the finance ministry has cut its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 1.9% even as inflation approaches the central bank's target. The combination of subdued growth, persistent borrowing costs, and a long-running EU subsidy investigation linked to opposition leader Andrej Babiš is creating a mood of cautious resignation rather than recovery. For ordinary Czechs, calmer prices have not yet translated into a tangible sense of improvement.
